drafts.quotation: Caesar posted Agrippa on the left
drafts.rationale: The passage places Agrippa on the left wing of the battle line. The engagement is the Actium narrative begun at 65.1, which is context for identifying the event only. Agrippa is named directly.

drafts.subject: chr:entity:augustus
drafts.quotation: reserved the right wing for himself
drafts.rationale: In Plutarch's Actium narrative, "Caesar" denotes Octavian, later Augustus, not Julius Caesar. The passage places him in command of the right wing of the line. The engagement is Actium, as established by the surrounding narrative.
